name: DriverQualificationFileManager
tagline: Never dispatch a driver with an expired licence or medical card – driver qualification files, renewals, onboarding and audits in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete driver qualification file (DQF) app for motor carriers, private fleets and 3PLs. Tracks the driving licence, medical certificate, annual MVR and review, Clearinghouse query, road test, application, previous employer check and hazmat training of every driver; flags qualified drivers with gaps as Remove from dispatch; an expiries calendar and file matrix for renewals; an onboarding board from applicant to qualified with validated rules; document requests, internal file audits and an audit pack – in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages. Compliance aid – validate against the regulations that apply to your fleet.
features: Nine item types: expiry dates, annual checks with intervals and one-time items with a deadline after hire
Remove from dispatch rule for qualified drivers with an expired or missing item
Expiries calendar with horizon 30–365 days, Request and Record per item, Request all
File matrix drivers × items, colour by state, click to record
Onboarding board Applicant → In review → Qualified → Suspended → Inactive with drag and drop and validated qualification
Document requests with Awaiting driver tracking
Internal file audits, audit sample, audit pack (AuditPackJson)
14 checks with fail / warn and next step, Act now list
Grid with search, sort, grouping, bulk request / audit / officer, CSV export, paging
Create / edit with validation, undo, back / forward
Power Fx outputs and six events; DriversCsv, ActionListJson, SummaryJson
